wiki_acceptance: Designating a built wall -> a pawn removes it, refunds material, the cell becomes walkable.
summary: Full Deconstruct flow implemented within lane A's 3 owned files + 1 new .meta. ZERO SceneSetup hot-file budget spent (toggle button self-attaches to the existing Canvas like GuiControlBar.EnsureInScene; designation marker is a runtime code-built TextMesh). No new pathfinding introduced - the deconstruct action reuses the existing build/haul stand-cell + WorkGiveUp + DistanceToFootprint pathing wholesale. Cell-walkable is achieved via the EXISTING WallEntity.OnDestroy -> PathGrid.SetStructureBlocked(false) ref-count decrement, symmetric to WallEntity.Start's increment.
files_touched: skills/game-prototype/unity-project/Assets/Scripts/DeconstructDesignation.cs (NEW: self-bootstrapping designation+input-mode manager + DeconstructTarget marker component)

skills/game-prototype/unity-project/Assets/Scripts/PawnBuilder.cs (deconstruct ACTION: SetDeconstructTarget/WalkToDeconstruct/UpdateDeconstruct/ClearDeconstructTask + HasTask now reports either build OR deconstruct)

skills/game-prototype/unity-project/Assets/Scripts/AI/PathGrid.cs (added symmetric named BlockWallCell/ReleaseWallCell wrappers over the existing ref-counted SetStructureBlocked, so the #15 decrement reads with intent next to the build increment)
files_NOT_touched_per_lane: AudioBank.cs (only called read-only via existing AudioBank.Instance?.PlaySelect() on toggle click - wiki #5 reuse, no edit)
PawnUtilityAI.cs / PawnContext.cs / PawnActions.cs (deconstruct dispatch is owned by the manager, NOT wired through the utility-AI action list, to stay in lane)

design.manager_discipline: Mirrors AlertStackUI.cs / RainSoundDriver.cs EXACTLY: [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] spawns one hidden DontDestroyOnLoad GO; FindFirstObjectByType idempotency guard; READ-ONLY poll-find of BuildManager / Canvas / PawnBuilders each frame (no OnEnable singleton capture - bug-pattern #7 firewall); timing via Time.unscaledTime deltas in Update, NOT a WaitForSeconds heartbeat (bug-pattern #9 firewall - no new background timer).
design.mode: Deconstruct mode toggled via self-built '해체 (X)' Canvas button + X hotkey; mutually exclusive with BuildManager build mode (each cancels the other so one left-click never fires both handlers); right-click / ESC cancels.
design.mark: Left-click in mode -> Physics2D.OverlapBox at the clicked cell center -> if a WallEntity/DoorEntity/StoveEntity/BedEntity, attach a DeconstructTarget marker (red TextMesh ✕, sortingOrder 30) + ClickEffect. Idempotent (re-click returns existing marker).
design.dispatch: Throttled (0.5s) read-only poll: for each unclaimed marked target, find the nearest IDLE builder (HasTask==false, not drafted/sleeping/breaking/manual) and SetDeconstructTarget - exactly how BuildBlueprintAction hands a builder a blueprint, but assigned directly by the manager to avoid editing the utility-AI files (out of lane).
design.action: PawnBuilder.UpdateDeconstruct mirrors the build branch: same WorkGiveUp give-up, same TryReserveWorkStandPos adjacent reserved stand cell, same DistanceToFootprint in-range test, same construction-skill/trait/ability-scaled per-frame AddWork accumulation. A builder works EITHER a blueprint OR a deconstruct target (SetDeconstructTarget drops any build task first).
design.refund: ~50% of build cost on completion via ResourceManager.AddWood/AddStone: wall 5->2 (wood or stone by WallEntity.Material), door 3->1, stove 10->5, bed 8->4 (bed footprint 1x2).
design.cell_walkable: On CompleteRemoval the WallEntity is Destroy()'d; WallEntity.OnDestroy already calls PathGrid.SetStructureBlocked(cell,false) (ref-count decrement + Version bump -> in-flight pawns re-path), the exact symmetric inverse of WallEntity.Start's RegisterWallCell increment. No extra grid call needed; doors/stoves/beds never registered a blocker.

qa_flags: SCENE-WIRING (button): the '해체 (X)' deconstruct-mode toggle button is created at RUNTIME on the first Canvas found (anchored bottom-center, x-offset -360 to avoid overlapping the centered GuiControlBar, y inset 104 above the bar). It is NOT wired in any SceneSetup file. QA: confirm the button appears, click toggles deconstruct mode (orange active highlight), and the X hotkey toggles it.

SCENE-WIRING (marker): the designation marker is a code-generated red '✕' TextMesh (Arial OS font, sortingOrder 30) parented to the marked structure - no imported PNG / no prefab / no SceneSetup ref. QA: confirm a red ✕ appears on a clicked wall and disappears on removal.

VERIFY #15 end-to-end: enter deconstruct mode, click a built wall -> red ✕ marker; an idle colonist walks to an adjacent stand cell and removes it after ~3s of work; wood/stone count rises by ~50% of build cost; a pawn can then path through the now-open cell (PathGrid Version bumped, in-flight pawns re-path).

NO HOT-FILE EDIT this wave: the lane's single SceneSetup hot-file budget was NOT spent. If QA prefers the toggle routed through GuiControlBar's bar instead of a free-floating self-attached button, that would be a follow-up (GuiControlBar.cs is outside lane A's owned-file proof, so it was intentionally not edited here).
